title: Corrigendum: Walk-in-Interview for appointing Guest Faculty in Commerce

source.name: Department of Laws, Panjab University, Chandigarh

text:
KEY LINES:
Reference No. BBPUCC/ 14618 Dated: 16.09.2025
12.09.2025 on this portal, the walk-in-Interview for the appointment of Guest Faculty in Commerce at
Baba Balraj Panjab University Constituent College, Balachaur scheduled for 23/09/2025 at 12.00noon has
been postponed to 30/09/2025 at 1.30pm and the venue and other conditions will remain the same.
